SL=1024;P=256
slate_maps={k:np.ones((SL,SL,4),np.float32) for k in ['albedo','normal','roughness']}
def stone_band(seed,freq,size=256,stretch=1):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);raw=rng.standard_normal((size,size))
 fy,fx=np.meshgrid(np.fft.fftfreq(size),np.fft.fftfreq(size),indexing='ij')
 filtered=np.fft.ifft2(np.fft.fft2(raw)*np.exp(-.5*((fx*size/freq)**2+(fy*size/(freq*stretch))**2))).real
 return np.clip(filtered/max(filtered.std(),1e-6),-2.5,2.5)
for variant in range(16):
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:P,0:P];u=xx/(P-1)*.55;v=yy/(P-1)*.72
 grain=stone_band(800+variant,58);body=stone_band(900+variant,4,stretch=.6)
 # Shallow broken mineral laminae, not a crumpled or painted skin.
 h=.000065*grain+.00009*body;tone=body*2.0+grain*.35
 for j in range(3):
  trace=.10+j*.20+.014*np.sin(u*8+variant+j)
  lamina=np.tanh((v-trace)/.0025)*(.45+.55*np.clip(np.sin(u*11+j+variant),0,1))
  h+=lamina*.00018;tone+=lamina*1.5
 dust=np.clip(.20+.14*body+.14*np.sin(u*8+variant),0,.55)
 base=np.array([67,76,78])+((variant%4)-1.5)*1.5
 rgb=(base+tone[:,:,None])*(1-dust[:,:,None]*.32)+np.array([94,90,79])*dust[:,:,None]*.32
 gy,gx=np.gradient(h);n=np.stack([-gx*(P-1)/.55,-gy*(P-1)/.72,np.ones_like(h)],-1);n/=np.linalg.norm(n,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 rough=np.clip(.81+.045*dust+.012*body+.012*grain,.73,.94)
 x=variant%4*P;y=variant//4*P
 slate_maps['albedo'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=np.clip(rgb/255,0,1)
 slate_maps['normal'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=n*.5+.5
 slate_maps['roughness'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=rough[:,:,None]
mat=mineral_materials['Slate'][0]
for suffix,arr in slate_maps.items():
 path=out/('HarborCraft_WeatheredSlate_'+suffix+'.png');png(path,arr)
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if suffix=='albedo' else 'Non-Color';im.pack()
 for node in mat.node_tree.nodes:
  if node.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and node.image and suffix in node.image.name:node.image=im
for node in mat.node_tree.nodes:
 if node.type=='NORMAL_MAP':node.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.80
mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.23
roof_tiles=[]
for ob in c.objects:
 if ob.type!='MESH' or not ob.data.materials or ob.data.materials[0]!=mat:continue
 if ' slate ' not in ob.name and 'Gallery slate' not in ob.name:continue
 coords=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in ob.data.vertices]);seed=sum((j+1)*ord(ch) for j,ch in enumerate(ob.name))
 if 'Gallery slate' in ob.name:
  top_count=4;direction=Vector((0,1,.345)).normalized();cross=Vector((1,0,0))
  for vertex in ob.data.vertices:vertex.co.z+=.009*(1-(vertex.co.y-coords[:,1].min())/max(.001,coords[:,1].ptp() if hasattr(coords[:,1],'ptp') else np.ptp(coords[:,1])))
 else:
  top_count=len(ob.data.vertices)//2
  top=coords[:top_count];xmin=top[:,0].min();xmax=top[:,0].max()
  # Down-slope direction from the higher tile edge to the lower one.
  xhigh=top[top[:,2].argmax(),0];xlow=top[top[:,2].argmin(),0]
  a=Vector(tuple(top[top[:,2].argmax()]));b=Vector(tuple(top[top[:,2].argmin()]));b.y=a.y
  direction=(b-a).normalized();cross=Vector((0,1,0))
  for j in range(top_count):
   vtx=ob.data.vertices[j];t=(vtx.co.x-xhigh)/(xlow-xhigh) if abs(xlow-xhigh)>.001 else 0
   lift=.003+max(0,min(1,t))*(.013+.004*(seed%3))
   vtx.co.z+=lift
   # Retain a thin true slate edge below each raised lower lip.
   ob.data.vertices[j+top_count].co.z=vtx.co.z-.026
  # Split-edge arris produces highlights only where a real thickness turns.
  mod=ob.modifiers.new('Cleaved slate arris','BEVEL');mod.width=.0035;mod.segments=1
 uv=ob.data.uv_layers[0];ps=[Vector(v.co) for v in ob.data.vertices[:top_count]]
 lowu=min(p.dot(cross) for p in ps);lowv=min(p.dot(direction) for p in ps)
